title: Application to Student Visa Process Steps for Germany
notice: 1 EUR ≈ 119 BDT (approximate). Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) is NOT a fee — it is your own living money that can be withdrawn monthly (max 992 EUR/month) after arriving in Germany. APS Certificate is mandatory for Bangladeshi students before applying to any German university.

processSteps.label: APS Certificate : Academic evaluation for Bangladeshi students
bullets: Apply at German Embassy Dhaka — required before university application
Fee: ~10,000–12,000 BDT | Processing time: ~6 weeks
Documents needed: SSC, HSC, Bachelor's certificates & transcripts, NID/Passport copy

processSteps.label: University Application : via uni-assist.de or direct university portal
bullets: uni-assist fee: ~75 EUR (first university) + 30 EUR each additional
Winter Semester deadline: usually January–July | Summer Semester: July–January
Prepare: CV, Motivation Letter, 2 Reference Letters, IELTS/TOEFL, transcripts

processSteps.label: Admission Letter & Blocked Account Setup
bullets: Open Sperrkonto with Coracle, Expatrio, or Deutsche Bank
Deposit: 11,904 EUR/year (~14,18,000 BDT) — 2024 requirement
Receive Blocked Account Confirmation Letter for visa application

processSteps.label: Health Insurance Arrangement
bullets: Public health insurance (TK, AOK, Barmer): ~110–130 EUR/month
Required for visa application and Residence Permit
Student rate valid up to age 30 or 14th semester

processSteps.label: Student Visa Application at VFS Global Dhaka / German Embassy
bullets: Visa fee: 75 EUR (~9,000 BDT) — paid at embassy
Book VFS Global appointment in advance: vfsglobal.com/Germany/Bangladesh
VFS service fee: ~30–35 EUR (~4,000 BDT)
Processing time: 8–12 weeks — apply early

processSteps.label: Arrive in Germany & Register (Anmeldung)
bullets: Register at Einwohnermeldeamt (City Hall) within 2 weeks of arrival
Receive Steuer-ID (Tax ID) and register with health insurance provider
Apply for Residence Permit at Ausländerbehörde (Immigration Office)

processSteps.label: Residence Permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) — conversion from entry visa
bullets: Apply at local Ausländerbehörde with enrollment certificate, blocked account proof, insurance
Fee: ~100 EUR
Initially issued for 1–2 years; renewable for duration of studies

costSteps.label: APS Certificate Fee : ~10,000–12,000 BDT — academic evaluation for BD students
uni-assist Application Fee : ~75 EUR (first university) + 30 EUR each additional
Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) : 11,904 EUR (~14,18,000 BDT) — refunded monthly after arrival
Student Visa Fee : 75 EUR (~9,000 BDT) — paid at German Embassy
VFS Global Service Fee : ~30–35 EUR (~4,000 BDT) — visa submission
Residence Permit Fee : ~100 EUR — paid at Ausländerbehörde after arrival
Semester Contribution : 150–350 EUR/semester — includes transport pass in many states
